text: 金十数据7月21日讯，海天味业公告，2026年7月21日，公司通过集中竞价交易方式首次实施公司A股股份回购，回购股份数为824,115股，已回购股份占公司总股本的比例为0.0141%，回购成交的最高价为人民币37.37元/股，最低价为人民币36.15元/股，成交总金额为人民币29,990,999元（不含交易费用）。
text_en: Jin10 Data July 21 - Haitian Flavouring announced that on July 21, 2026, the company implemented its first A-share repurchase via centralized bidding, repurchasing 824,115 shares, representing 0.0141% of the company's total share capital. The highest repurchase price was 37.37 yuan per share, the lowest was 36.15 yuan, and the total transaction amount was 29,990,999 yuan (excluding transaction fees).
